[spoiler=Clean up in the west (Exp.5)]
[b][u]Cleaning up and securing the western end of the Red Wall mountain.[/u][/b]
In the end of the year 1950, not long after the end of the Noble War and the destruction of the Noble faction (or so it was belived), the nation of Nordiheim was going trough the stuff they had captured from them and taking out any pockets of remaining Noble forces that refused to surrender.
One of these pockets of left over forces was discovered to be located westwards at the western end of the Red Wall mountain in a fortcated military base that Nordiheim had not known even existed untill the start of the war when a Noble army division, the 4th Royal Division, had come from that direction in a failed attack on the capitol of Midgard early on in the war and recon plains had been sendt out in that direction to figure out were they had come from.
It was determied that it was most likely one of several fortified military bases that the Nobles had constructed in secret over the many years that they had been planing their violent comeback and joust like all the others it had been made so that it was difficult to see from a distance as it was not only made in a similar color as the sorounding terrain but also built partialy into the mountain.

Even if the lingering soldiers that was left there would not be in full numbers and have no were to get reinforcements and supplies from they still posed a danger to the securrity of the area and the citizens of Nordiheim that lived near there, and as such could not be ignored in any capacity, as such the council of Nordiheim and it military ordered it taken care of.
Though there was also the principal of it all as Nordiheim as a whole had allready decided that no remnants of the Nobles faction and their army were to be permited to remain, be it inside or outside the nation.

There was still the matter of the area that this base was situated on though, while Nordiheim for the most part viewed the entierity of the Red Wall mountain as Nordiheimian it had not been fully and propperly claimed by them, such was the case of this western part of it were there was only some smaller claims over the area and about two or three villages made by Nordiheimians.
There did live a few tribes of Aboriginals there though with distant ties to the Aboriginals of Aboria and Midland but they for the most part joust wanted to live in peace following the old ways, they would have to be aproched before a military expedition could be sendt into the area to deal with the military base and its remaining occupants.

[b][u]Negotiations with the western mountain people.[/u][/b]
When Nordiheims diplomats aproched the Aboriginals of the western part of the Red Wall mountain it was quickly discovered that they were much more aprochable then initialy asumed, it seemed that during the Noble war the forces of the nobles had not only marched uninvited trough their land but also made themself a makeshift road straight trough their most important burial site without any care, as such they welcomed the Nordiheimians plans to take out the noble army remnants in the area.
They even gave them premission to use said makeshift road but the lead diplomat that Nordiheim had chosen for the effort, one Koa Tidason from Aboria, flat out rejected the idea on pure religious and spiritual principles and instead insisted that Nordiheim would make a new path around the site so as to not further disturb its spiritual balance, while the other diplomats was at first torn on the matter it seemed that the locals very much apriciated Koas staunch stance to not disturb the spirits of the dead and as such the negotiations and talks with them would go quite smoothly all tings considered.

At the end of the negotiations the council of Nordiheim was informed that not only did they get the blessing of the local people to travel trough the area together with were their important sites were so that they could avoid desecrate them and give them what information they had on the noble army remnants, the local Aboriginals even agreed to let Nordiheim formaly claim the area as theirs with them becoming citizens as long as they swore on the great spirits to allow them to continue their life as they desired and respect their more simple way of life.
This was someting that the council realy have a problem agreeing to as it was similar to what some people was allready allowed to do in the more remote spiritual areas of the nation anyway.

From the information that the native people provided on the noble army remnants a couple of things was learned;
The remnant was that of the 15th Royal Mechanized Brigade, a brigade that was belived to have been part of the failed attack on the Nordiheimian capitol and the only part of that attack that had managed to withdraw with any success in the aftermath as they had slipped away during the night while Nordiheimian forces was occopied with the attacks tank brigade.
They seemed to have started calling themself "Thryms Brigade" ,after their leader Major Thrym, after the fall of the Noble faction a few month ago wich also indicated that they had been able to comunicate with them even though they were one of the more isolated army groups.
The locals also told them that they seemed to be gathering any criminals and outlaws that they could get in contact with from the sorounding areas, it had to be asumed that they either knew their location was known or that they were planing someting, somting that Nordiheim would put a permanent stop to.
The local Aboriginals was also able to inform Nordiheim about the amount of men that the "Thryms Brigade" had left of their original number of 7500, wich was the standard size of a Royal Mechanized Brigade, as they had observed them closely when they had originaly withdrawn back to their base, roughly 3500-4000 had been observed to be left of the brigade wich meant that they were more or less at half their original strenght and meant that they were still a potentialy dangerous group especialy since they seemed to be recruiting people to fill their ranks ones more.

The council of Nordiheim would order the Nordiheimian army to make all due haste to make a path to this base and take care of the "Thryms Brigade" before they could gather enough strenght to become a propper treath, or perhaps worse then that to stop them from deciding to spread out and become a well organized group of bandits and raiders that could potentialy destabilize the western half of Nordiheim.
The road to the Thryms Brigades base would be finised in the new year of 1951.

[b][u]Dealing with the Thryms Brigade.[/u][/b]

Colonel Tormod "Bakstur" Marlison, a veteran of the Noble War, had been chosen to lead the mission to crush the Thryms Brigade together with officers that he could chose as he saw fit,
Under his command a small Nordiheimian army was placed, the 2nd Midland Mobile Division, the 3rd and 4th Midland Mountain Brigades and the 5th Vestland Tank Brigade, aswell as being given the ability to call in air support as he needed.
The plan was relativly simple, surround the Thryms Brigade in their base of operations and attack from all fronts together with air attacks to quickly take out any larger weapons or vehicles they had and force them into their base to contain them compleatly.
He would deploy his force in three mobile brigades to soround the Thryms Brigade with 2 of them going the long way around to come at them from the noth-west and south-west to block off the only two other real paths that went up into the area, someting that the locals had told them about.

The operation started in the begining of april and in its first stage was not detected by the Thryms Brigade before the encirclement had been completed thanks to the work of the local Aboriginals who had been pretending to be obedient to them out of fear of violent repricals.
The Thryms Brigade would put up a fierce resistance though as there was no tactic or action that was beneat them and as such the fight could at best be described as "nasty" even though it only took a week for the Nordiheimian forces to push the Thryms Brigade from the immidiate soroundings of their base and down into its underground complex with their greater numbers, air superiority and fully equiped units.
Only joust above 2000 men of the Thryms Brigade, most of them being from the original survivors, took shelter in the underground complex of their base for their "final stand".

Colonel Tormod had no interest in sending the men under his command into the underground complex as he knew that "Major" Thrym, being from the Noble army, would most likely use the place to enact a grusome battle of attrition to inflict as many cassualties as possible on his forces as the Noble army had tried in the Noble War, someting that they had at times succeeded at.
Instead he ordered is men to build a fortification around the base and contain them in their base and sendt an ultimatum to Major Thrym, "surrender and face fair judgement or be subject to whatever I feal like doing to your little underground base, but I will not give you the attack into your base complex that you are hoping for", one persone would come up with a white flag to "talk" to the colonel.

This man, one of Thryms lieutenants from the look of his uniform and insignias, would at first come up with the a air about him that made Tormod understand that they did not fully take his treath of "be subject to whatever I feal like" seriusly but he would make him to take it seriusly before he went back to his commander.
He personaly showed him the preparations they were making and what exactly he planed to do with what could be called a cold and decided aura about him, he showed the man the artilery batteries that was being prepared and supplied with stocpiles of amunitions, explained to him about the rocket launcher systems they were going to test and how they would fire colored smoke rockets on spesific places on the base for the bombers and other aircraft to train their aim at.
Essentialy he was going to use the base as target practice for Nordiheimian forces until what remained of the Thryms Brigade either succumbed to "shell shock", starvation or whatever ells would happen to them, he had absolutely no intentions of giving them a chance to scrape out some type of honorable defeat trough taking as many Nordiheimian men as they could, he had learned all about their tactics from the Noble war in person, instead he told the man that the only way that he and his fellow soldiers would be able to die with honor in battle was to come out of their base and have their blood stain the ground under the gaze of the gods they belived in, and if they should in any way be able to survive it all he would show them exactly why their fellow noble soldiers had given him the nickname "Bakstur" wich he took great pride in.

The message seemed to get trough to the guy as not only was he shown the evidence that the colonel was dead serious in his treath and that everyting was being sett up to do exactly what he said they would do, but there could also be seen a recognition of who the comander of the Nordiheimian forces was, it seemed that even they had heard of the exploits and tactics of Colonel Tormod "Barbie" Marlison and how he got his nickname of "Bakstur" from both sides of the war.
Ones he returned back down into the base to report what he had been told Colonel Tormod would only need to wait about a day before he would find out what their chose was, as the sun had started to rise the next day the entire remnant of the Thryms Brigade would come out in a suicide charge towards the Nordiheimian fortified encirclement so that they could die on the field of combat regardless of how doomed they were, it did not take the Nordiheiman force long to send them to the after life and what ever awaited them there, Major Thrym himself would be found and identified among the bodies of his men after the fighting ended later that day.

At the end of april the issue of the Thryms Brigade would be considered solved, in the report that was given to the minister of war it was said that at most only 100 of the Thryms Brigade was belived to have escaped as a carefull minimum estimate.
In tottal only 1692 Nordiheimian soldiers had been killed or wounded in the operation while the Thryms Brigade had been wiped out, from the bodies that had been counted and information foun within the now captured base, wich the nobles had named vestreborgi, it was found that the brigades numbers when they were engaged had been 3927 of their original numbers and about 2190 "new recruits" with about 500 more on the way from their latest "recruitment drive" in the south, this group of 500 recruits had been successfully found and uprehended together with the last 12 surviving memeber of the Thryms Brigade.

[b][u]Integrating the western Red Wall Mountain.[/u][/b]

Trough the 1950s the western area that contained the western end of the Red Wall mountain would be quietly made into a propper official part of the Midland region, a railway would be made out to the Vestreborgi military base as it was repaired and turned into the most westward military base that Nordiheim had with its elevated position making it a good choise for upgrading into a long range observation and radar base in the 60s and 70s to enable Nordiheim to keep an eye on any potential treaths that might show up there.
A few roads were also made trough the area to enable easier travel, though they were carefull to avoid any sites of religious or cultural importance to the local Aboriginals, though the area would at this point be seen by many as a bit of a frontier area by many including the people living there.

While in the begining there would not be to many people moving into the area that would change in 1972 when a prospecter would bring back news about finding a proof of quartz deposits wiht gem stone quality potential at the foot of the mountain, this created a sharp uptick in the number of people living there as people traveled into the area to look for and mine for quartz stones in the hope of making a fortune, this led to the creation of small towns over the years in those places that good quality stones could be found with the most commenly found being high grade rose quartz gems.
This increase in local population meant a need for transportation to bring in tings that the people needed while bringing out what they ended up mining, as such the "round about" railway was made that went around the foot of the Red Wall mountain from vestland all the way to Aboria and linked into the railway that went along all of Nordiheim from Lake Lifvatn and to the northern coast of Ostland.

In 1984 a decently sized deposit of galena was found in the area that was of great interest to the industry of Nordiheim, this together with the creation of a local refinery to extract the silver and lead of the galena ore would leed to a increase of available jobs in the area that would boost the standard of living in the area and jump start a increase in the standard of living for the local people wich would bring it up to par of the rest of the nation be the 90s and propperly solidify it as part of Midland and no longer as frontier land.

By the late 90s and early two thousand the iron mining companies of Midland would start up mines in the area as it had deposits of this metal joust like the rest of the Midland region, though they had to abide by the agreement that had been made with the local Aboriginals when they allowed Nordiheim to make the area a offical part of the nation, as such the large iron deposit that was discovered under their spiritual burila site could not be mined no matter how much the stockholders complained (and some did complain a lot).
The local Aboriginals was pleased that the old agreement was still being upheld even though they had to deal with some people that tried to bully them into allowing their employers to mine there wich only led to them being captured by the Aboriginals, that showed them that they were fully able to defend themself even with ancient weapons like the boomerang, and handed over to Nordland law enforcement who put them on trial for armed assult and violent coercion together with their overconfident employer wich landed them a "nice" stay in prison.
Other stockholders and mining companies was subsequently warned by the council of Nordiheim that they would not tollerate anyone trying someting like that again and that they would crack down hard on anyone that even dared to atempt it, they then declared the locations of the local Aboriginals as protected religous and cultural sites.

In the modern era the area is not much different then the rest of the mountaines (in the eyes of the Nordiheimian) Midland region when it comes to the standard of living and how the people that live there behave and do tings, the only noteworthy differences are the population density, the higher consentration of protected locations and the amount of natives that live there that follow more strictly the old ways of living.
As a result of this you are more likely to be able to spot a wild Iron Drake lazing around on the rocky surface of the mointain there, it is also the are were the most shamans of the nations biggest religion, Draconic Spiritualism, come from and often go to for meditation and spirit communications as they say that the area have many spirits combined with high spiritual tranquility and balance wich is important for their ability to do their religious duty and preserve their own spiritual balance.
[/spoiler]

[b]Official FEFA Announcement: Erene World Cup[/b]

The Federation of Erene Football Association (FEFA) announces the launch of the first (to my knowledge) Erene World Cup, the intercontinental tournament is bringing together national teams and fans from across Erene. Any nation can ask to register into the tournament freely, by telegramming this account or telegramming [nation]Valddera[/nation]. The tournament also begins in June, roleplay time. Any nation would be free to ask for registering in the tournament before June.

Tournament Format: to ensure a fair and dynamic competition, FEFA has adopted the following structure:
[b]1: Group Stage[/b] - The final amount of teams will be divided into a certain amount of groups depending on the amount of teams, Each group has the Standard point system:
3 points for a win
1 point for a draw
0 points for a loss

Each team plays a certain amount of matches to qualify, and only a few teams can advance into the knockout stages.

[b]2: Knockout Stage[/b] - The teams who advanced from the group stages will enter a single elimination bracket consisting of:
Round of 16
Quarter finals
Semi Finals
Third place Match
Final match

[b]Matches[/b] - A full match schedule, including group allocations, fixture dates and match results with details and scores will be also featured in the tournament.

[b]Want to host the tournament?[/b] - Hosting the tournament has a few rules, you must submit a telegram or an RMB post to this account or [nation]Valddera[/nation], writing on why you should host the tournament, your nation mustn't be at war, Your nation must have atleast 8 stadiums, or you can build ones. And you'd need to tell me the names of the cities that the tournament will be played at, and the name of the stadiums too.

[b]Group stage slots:[/b] https://postimg.cc/30GrxLm9

[i]The slots can increase depending on how many nations will join.[/i]

[b]Optional requirements[/b]: if you want realism, you can choose to make an entire 11 squad, three substitute players and submit it through a telegram to this account or [nation]Valddera[/nation]. You must also include the number of the players and what position they play.

[spoiler=2025/3/9] Following the attacks in Horgingtonia last month, Lamandican Parliament discussed whatever to do with the colony. Some argued that the land is strategic as it gives Lamandica a foothold in Vespurian affairs and as an important trade region. However, the counterargument was that last year in 2026, the region lost Lamandica billions in Pelops, with 2027 projected to see even more losses. Besides, Lamandica has acknowledged that they had infringed on tribal land without respect or consent of those living there prior. After a week of negotiations and sessions, the concessions outweighed the arguments for staying, and on Tuesday, March 9th, 2027, Parliament came to the decision to relinquish claims of Horgingtonia, but will try to sell the oil-rich region to another nation, most likely to one of the nations that had rented terminals at the port of Puerto Encarnacion (Camphill, Nederlandse staat, Yulandburg, and Italian Dutch), in order to get some money back from the failure. 

While compromises and compensations will be further discussed to those involved in the ordeal of Horgingtonia, the government has announced a tax raise for Lamandican citizens in order to offset lost investments in Horgingtonia. Many Lamandicans had already been opposed to Lamandicas colony in Vespuria when they possessed it in 2025. Though there have been protests against it, especially when the colony was chosen as the means to gain oil for Lamandica instead of simply trading with other nations, they have been minimal until the tax raise was announced. We didnt want this, we never wanted this. Yet, we have to take the hit for the governments little petrol-dream and play-projects in Mandalay Bay. Ill [expletive] rather put all my money in bulk on an airplane, and watch it crash into the ocean before Id [expletive] do that, best put talk-show host Filiab Celovinluvy on KILRD in Mitremtion after this was announced. Article VI of the Lamandican Constitution states No federal entity, shall impose of increase tariff on its own without consent of those they govern. Guess [expletive] what? I, no, WE NEVER GAVE CONSENT! EAT THAT CALIENO CRONIES!

Its yet to see how citizens will react with massive anti-government and anti-corruption protests most likely to occur over the following weekend, though Calieno-Ruiz advised Lamandican Highway Patrol, Constabularies, and the National Guard to be on high alert for unrest across the confederacy over the next few weeks. [/spoiler]
